description: This file declares functions related to network bridge management, such as initializing, shutting down, and iterating over bridge ports and bridges. It provides platform-specific inline implementations for non-Linux systems.

methods.name: int br_init(void)
methods.description: Initializes bridge subsystem; on Linux, it is declared but undefined here; on other systems, it returns 0.

methods.name: void br_shutdown(void)
methods.description: Shuts down bridge subsystem; on Linux, declared but undefined; on other systems, it is a no-op.

methods.name: int br_foreach_port(const char * brname,int (* iterator)(const char * br,const char * port,void * arg),void * arg)
methods.description: Iterates over each port in a bridge; on Linux, this is a function pointer; on other systems, it returns 0.

methods.name: int br_foreach_bridge(int (* iterator)(const char *,void *),void * arg)
methods.description: Iterates over each bridge; on Linux, a function pointer; elsewhere, returns 0.

ctags.name: br_foreach_port
ctags.signature: (const char * brname,int (* iterator)(const char * br,const char * port,void * arg),void * arg)
